events.name: Old Forester Bourbon Experience
events.info: The Ingersoll is bringing bourbon lovers an unforgettable evening of food, spirits, and storytelling with the Old Forester Bourbon Experience. Created specifically for the event, the five-course menu will take guests on a culinary journey through thoughtfully crafted dishes, each paired with a featured Old Forester bourbon. Every pairing has been selected to showcase the flavors, character, and versatility of the historic bourbon brand, offering guests an experience that goes beyond a traditional dinner. Leading the evening will be Jessi Lorraine, National Ambassador for Old Forester. Her extensive hospitality background and success in bartending competitions?including winning Speed Rack California in 2019?have helped shape her expertise in spirits and cocktail culture.
events.pleaseNote: The evening will begin with cocktails at 5:30 p.m., followed by a five-course dinner and bourbon tasting beginning at 6 p.m. Guests are invited to arrive no later than 5:45 p.m. to settle in before the experience begins. Whether you're a longtime bourbon enthusiast or simply looking for an elevated night out, the Old Forester Bourbon Experience offers an opportunity to enjoy exceptional food, expertly selected bourbon pairings, and an engaging presentation from one of Old Forester?s own ambassadors.

Boy Band Review
events.info: This is the best boy band tribute in the country, playing your favorite hits from NSYNC, Backstreet Boys, NKOTB, One Direction, and more! They have captured the hearts of fans with their boyband shows, transporting audience members back in time to the days of frosted tips and hunky frontmen professing their undying love. This is incredible throwback experience includes a full band, choreography, harmonies, and is everyone's favorite show since the 1990s! Your ticket includes our house greens salad with choice of dressing, basket of dinner rolls with butter, and a selection of entrée options, along with coffee, tea, and water. All other drinks such as alcohol, soda, starters, entrée upgrades and desserts are available for purchase during your Ingersoll dining experience. Dining begins two hours before showtime.
